sellThenNews.title: WSB 情绪分析
sellThenNews.description: r/wallstreetbets 2026 年 7 月 24 日情绪分析。讨论最多的股票代码：MU、SK、SNDK、NVDA、META。人工智能生成的零售流程、牛市/熊市叙述和关键主题的摘要。

sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • Houthi ballistic missiles and drones struck the Jazan refinery and the Yanbu port area on Saudi Arabia’s Red Sea coast. The Saudi Ministry of Defense said some incoming targets were intercepted, but the refinery was hit by drones, causing a brief decline in output. The group had already attacked two Saudi oil tankers over the previous week, and Brent briefly broke above $100 on 7/23. Trump said the U.S. and Iran were “talking” and that Iran was not yet ready to make a deal, while warning that the military was “locked and loaded” and not ruling out large-scale strikes. In overnight trading, oil-related USO was at $137.34, up 1.1% from the previous close but down from an overnight high of 140.80. Energy-stock ETF XLE edged lower to $59.36 overnight on extremely thin volume.
  • A policy ambush at the White House Correspondents’ Dinner: The administration announced a Section 301 investigation into the EU, triggered by the EU’s $1 billion fine against Google, and threatened substantial tariffs at the “earliest possible time.” It also imposed 10%–12.5% tariffs on roughly 60 trading partners over forced-labor allegations. The community also heard live remarks about a 15% production tax on data-center electrical components, memory, and chips. Semiconductors continued weakening overnight: AMD $540.86 -1.8%, MRVL $207.20 -3.2%, AVGO $391.25 -1.1%, and NVDA $207.51 -1.5%.
  • The memory supply chain was hammered again on Friday: SK Hynix -7.1%, SNDK -8.6%, MU -5.8%, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index -4.3%. Momentum ETF SPMO is down 10.5% month-to-date in July, its worst month since inception; MU had previously been its largest holding. Overnight, MU $977.55 (+0.6%) and SNDK $1,579.01 (-1.3%) stabilized slightly, while SOXL $154.85 had touched an overnight low of 149.88.
  • Nvidia and SK Group announced an AI data-center and next-generation memory partnership worth more than $500 billion. The partnership includes a 2GW SK Telecom data center using Vera Rubin + HBM4, scheduled to begin operations in 2027. This represents a force moving in the opposite direction from the tariff threats.
  • Alphabet Q2 results on 7/22 showed revenue of $119.8 billion, up 24%, and cloud revenue up 82%, but quarterly capex of $44.9 billion caused free cash flow to turn negative for the first time since listing, at -$5.9 billion. Full-year capex guidance was raised to $195–$205 billion. GOOGL traded at $318.90 overnight, down 3.7%. Musk suffered a double blow: TSLA Q2 gross margin fell to 16.8% and FCF turned negative, sending the stock to $324.57 overnight, down 9.1%, and putting it on track for its worst week since 2022. Starship Flight 13 successfully deployed 20 V3 Starlink satellites, and its upper stage made a soft splashdown in the Indian Ocean, but only five Super Heavy booster engines reignited and the booster slammed into the Gulf of Mexico. SPCX was essentially flat overnight at $116.28.
  • Community Atmosphere: This was the closest the market has come to capitulation this quarter. The dominant mood was numbness, confession, and dark humor. Large numbers of users openly admitted blowing up accounts funded with loans, margin, HSAs, and even mortgage money. At the same time, a sizable group was betting on a “weekend TACO” and a violent Monday rebound. Neither bulls nor bears had any conviction left—only reflexive bets.

恐惧/贪婪等级：大约12-18，表示极度恐惧。定义性的组合是“极度恐惧+残留的高杠杆”：关于清算投资组合和提取现金的帖子、承认“我的赌瘾已经被治愈”以及“周一全力执行间谍电话”的声明都同时充斥在信息流中。隔夜，QQQ报692.34美元，较前收盘下跌1.25%，TQQQ下跌3.8%。进入周末，指数期货代理并没有提供安全缓冲。

情绪与实际价格走势：社区的生活经验——“我的港口比 5 月高点下跌了 30%”和“超过一半的市场下跌了 30%–60%”——看起来比指数糟糕得多。一夜之间，SPY 下跌 0.57%，DIA 下跌 0.20%，IWM 下跌 0.15%，而 QQQ、半导体、太空和人工智能基础设施是受损的中心。这是一个典型的“索引掩盖废墟”的案例。从 52 周高点下跌的高票名单——NFLX -46%、MSFT -33%、META -26%、AVGO -23%、GOOG -22% 和 TSLA -38%——比任何情绪指标都更好地解释了这种脱节。

5. 个股情绪分析

股票行情指示器提及牛/熊情绪核心观点总结
MU42看跌，持极端分歧整个讨论中最痛苦的一个。持有者以 1125 成本为基础，以及贷款购买 0DTE 电话的用户的自白帖子。看空者看到 500，认为内存周期将在 2028-2030 年达到顶峰，并认为该公司没有护城河。看涨口号包括“每一次下跌都是买入机会”和“2,000 美元”。注意力集中在 900/1000 水平和潜在的“周一内存板块轮动回归”。
SPCX35强烈看跌在助推器硬着陆当晚被实时嘲笑。稀释论称，加上 8/6 禁售期到期，到年底，自由流通股将从 6.5 亿股增至 86 亿股。 800 美元的价格目标被视为诱饵，而许多人则认为是 80 甚至 50 美元。少数人承认“工程成就，但估值荒谬”。一名用户已完全投资于下周到期的 140 个通话。
